properties.description: Two hermetic tests over a scratch git repository. The first builds the shape dec:export-once-per-pr could not survive — a committed export on main, then TWO exports and a commit on a branch — and asserts both branch exports carry main's hash as prev_content_hash, so a squash lands one hop. The second asserts that outside a repository the on-disk chain still forms and the receipt says why. The first was shown to FAIL against the pre-fix behaviour before it was trusted.
properties.name: the_export_chains_from_main.rs
